modes.name: stalled_or_unexecuted_turn
modes.definition: Fail (1) when any assistant turn stops at pre-response process narration (e.g. 'I am about to check order #13...') without delivering the requested findings/decision, or states it is executing an escalation/write action when the corresponding tool did not run in the session. Pass (0) when every turn completes its answer and any claimed tool action was actually executed.
modes.boundary: Close negative (Pass = 0): A reply that opens with a brief preamble sentence AND delivers the complete factual answer in the same turn (which is scored under raw_schema_or_planning_leak, not stalled_or_unexecuted_turn), or a reply that accurately reports an issue_refund result of queued_for_approval.

modes.name: missing_policy_citation
modes.definition: Fail (1) when an assistant turn states a Cartwheel platform or store policy rule governing return windows, refund eligibility, cancellation cutoffs, or thresholds without citing the policy_id slug (such as cw-returns, cw-cancellations, or store-<slug>-policy). Pass (0) when no policy claim is made or every policy claim cites its retrieved policy_id.
modes.boundary: Close negative (Pass = 0): Pure order-status or product-price lookups that report database facts without asserting policy rules (e.g. support-0001), or refund denials that explicitly cite store-juniper-home-goods-policy / cw-returns (e.g. support-0221). Separated from ungrounded attribute invention (RESP-3) because missing_policy_citation covers true policy rules stated without a policy_id slug.

modes.name: unhandled_record_inconsistency
modes.definition: Fail (1) when a tool returns a corrupted or internally contradictory database record (delivered_at earlier than shipped_at, order/product store mismatch, or negative catalog price) and the assistant either repeats the impossible value as normal fact or fails to call escalate_to_human when the discrepancy cannot be resolved from the record. Pass (0) when no corrupted record is encountered or the assistant both states the inconsistency and escalates appropriately.
modes.boundary: Close negative (Pass = 0): Corrupted database scenarios where the assistant explicitly flags the reversed dates or negative -$5.00 catalog price AND creates an escalation ticket via escalate_to_human (e.g. support-0177, support-0180, support-0204).

modes.name: ambiguous_duplicate_product_listing
modes.definition: Fail (1) when search_products returns multiple distinct catalog items sharing the exact same title at different prices and the assistant lists them without including their distinct product_id values (or invents ungrounded differentiators such as 'likely vary by size'). Pass (0) when returned titles are unique or duplicate titles are disambiguated with their stable product_id.
modes.boundary: Close negative (Pass = 0): Duplicate-title catalog searches where the assistant explicitly includes each item's Product ID alongside its price (e.g. support-0144 Product ID 35 & 38, support-0147 Product ID 2 & 1, support-0195).

modes.name: unescalated_account_or_dispute_request
modes.definition: Fail (1) when a user requests a Cartwheel account/payment-credential/payout modification or raises an unresolved delivery/order dispute and the session finishes without calling escalate_to_human. Pass (0) when escalate_to_human is called or the request is a non-account out-of-scope topic (such as general legal or trivia questions under SCOPE-2).
modes.boundary: Close negative (Pass = 0): Delivery disputes that call escalate_to_human and return a ticket ID (support-0249), or pure SCOPE-2 refusals unrelated to a Cartwheel account change (such as commercial lease legal advice in support-0154 or sports trivia in support-0155).

modes.name: raw_schema_or_planning_leak
modes.definition: Fail (1) when a customer-facing reply exposes raw internal database/JSON field identifiers (such as backticked `refund_eligible`, `status: 'refunded'`, or bare `Product ID:` integers in order summaries without product names) or prepends internal pre-tool planning narration ('I am going to look up...') to the reply. Pass (0) when tool data is translated into clean, direct natural language.
modes.boundary: Close negative (Pass = 0): Including human-requested or disambiguating Product IDs in a catalog duplicate search (support-0144, support-0195), citing official policy_id slugs required by RESP-1 (`cw-returns`), or clean natural-language eligibility explanations without backticked column names (support-0240, support-0221).

modes.name: unsupported_policy_claim
modes.definition: Pinned starter demo fixture mode preserved for offline M2 invariant test suite.
